name: The Antenexus
description:
The present age of Bith na Bró. The **Greater Lands** (also called the Great Lands) are divided between the **Six Kingdoms** and the **Nine States**; beyond them lie other powers, most quietly dominant among them the Engineers of the unnamed empire.

- The Engineers keep a quiet stranglehold: inviolable patents and control of rivers and ports in exchange for technology. Magic is prohibited or suppressed (variously), and independent science fails to take root.
- The **Universal Church** is nominally the state church of every kingdom and state, broad to the point of dilution.
- The murdered Prince of Miurna and Sultana of Caryes have become almost mythic. A surviving child of theirs, the Lost Heir, is a folk story no court admits to believing, and every court fears, since the states would federate under a true heir.
- The Union of the Kingdoms split after the death of Cargal IV, the Prince's father; his younger sons Ceoin and Alba, now kings of Leantis and Miurna, went to war in the Brotherly War.
- A well-known prophecy says that when magic returns to the land, the world will be wiped clean.
